probe.title: Stream: Private Voice Ring — Notes, Chat, Dictation
probe.text_sample: Stream: Private Voice Ring — Notes, Chat, Dictation shop.sandbar.com Paste this into Webflow Site settings > Custom code > Head code, below the Datadog snippet. No values need replacing. Why this exists: Shopify stamps an order's `landing_site` / `referring_site` from the URL the visitor arrives on at the *Shopify* domain. Almost every buyer reaches the store by clicking through sandbar.com, so Shopify sees a plain referral from www.sandbar.com and records the order as coming from our own site. The original campaign is lost: over 2026-06-07..2026-08-06, 1,603 of 1,948 orders (82.3%) were self-referrals with no recoverable channel. This script carries the acquisition params across that hop. It stores them for the browsing session and appends them to every outbound link to the store, so the visitor lands on shop.sandbar.com with the campaign intact and Shopify records it on the order. The params must end up in the href: shop.sandbar.com is Shopify-hosted, so we cannot run code there to read a cookie.
